_comment: Curated PS4 Fusion OS compatibility seed. Statuses reflect the realistic ceiling of the 8-core Jaguar / GCN Liverpool-Neo. Every entry is a starting hint, NOT a guarantee; measured_status on a profile is only ever set by a real run on target.
